title.zh: 杜鲁门承认以色列的声明

caption.en: The statement approved on 14 May 1948 recognizes Israel’s provisional government as the de facto authority. Handwritten changes specify the state’s name.
caption.zh: 1948年5月14日批准的声明承认以色列临时政府为事实上的当局。手写修改明确了国家名称。

alt.en: A typed statement on cream paper, with crossed-out words, handwritten corrections, Harry Truman’s signature and a handwritten approval date.
alt.zh: 米色纸上的打字声明，带划除文字、手写修改、哈里·杜鲁门签名和手写批准日期。

interpretation.en: Handwritten changes identify the State of Israel, while the text recognizes its provisional government. The statement records a U.S. diplomatic decision during the war. Palestinian displacement and dispossession, central to the accompanying story, are absent from this document.
interpretation.zh: 手写修改明确了以色列国的名称，正文承认其临时政府。声明记录战争期间美国的一项外交决定。关联故事所述的巴勒斯坦人流离失所与财产丧失，没有出现在这份文书中。

items.creator: Harry S. Truman; Executive Office of the President
items.institution: Harry S. Truman Presidential Library; U.S. National Archives

note.en: An official presidential recognition statement, approved and signed by Truman in office. NARA identifies the exact item in Charles Ross Papers, “Handwriting of the President.” Federal authorship of this government statement, rather than its location in donated papers, supports public-domain reuse.
note.zh: 这是杜鲁门在任时批准签署的官方总统承认声明。国家档案馆将此件列入查尔斯·罗斯文书中的“总统手迹”。公有领域依据是该政府声明的联邦作者身份，而非其被收入捐赠文书。

creator.zh: 哈里·S. 杜鲁门；美国总统行政机构

institution.zh: 哈里·S. 杜鲁门总统图书馆；美国国家档案馆

title.en: Mandela arriving for a U.S. state visit
title.zh: 曼德拉抵达美国进行国事访问

caption.en: Colonel Acuff greets South African President Nelson Mandela beside his aircraft on 4 October 1994, during the first year of his presidency.
caption.zh: 1994年10月4日，阿卡夫上校在飞机旁迎接南非总统纳尔逊·曼德拉；当年是曼德拉就任总统的第一年。

alt.en: Nelson Mandela shakes hands with a uniformed officer beside an aircraft, while other visitors descend the stairs behind him.
alt.zh: 纳尔逊·曼德拉在飞机旁与一名军官握手，其他来宾在他身后走下舷梯。

interpretation.en: The military ceremony shows Mandela taking part in international diplomacy during his first year as president. His new role followed the 1994 election and the wider collective struggle against apartheid described in the biography.
interpretation.zh: 军事迎接仪式展现曼德拉在总统任期第一年参与国际外交。他的新角色承接1994年选举，以及传记所述更广泛的反种族隔离集体斗争。

items.creator: Linwood Moore; U.S. Department of Defense

note.en: NARA captions item 6493889 as Colonel Acuff greeting Mandela on 4 October 1994 and identifies the visit photographs with RG 330, Combined Military Service Digital Photographic Files, describing camera originals made by military photographers. Embedded item metadata credits Linwood Moore. This is an official federal service image.
note.zh: 国家档案馆注明条目6493889为1994年10月4日阿卡夫上校迎接曼德拉，并把访问照片归入RG 330联合军种数字照片档案，说明其为军事摄影人员拍摄的原始照片。嵌入条目元数据署名林伍德·摩尔。此件属官方联邦军务图像。

creator.en: Linwood Moore; U.S. Department of Defense
creator.zh: 林伍德·摩尔；美国国防部

transformation.zh: 逐字节保存机构图像版本；未作本地裁剪、缩放或重新编码。

title.en: Buzz Aldrin on the lunar surface
title.zh: 月球表面的巴兹·奥尔德林

caption.en: Neil Armstrong photographed Edwin “Buzz” Aldrin near the lunar module during Apollo 11. NARA dates the photograph to 20 July 1969.
caption.zh: 尼尔·阿姆斯特朗在阿波罗11号任务中拍摄月球舱附近的埃德温“巴兹”·奥尔德林。国家档案馆将照片记为1969年7月20日。

alt.en: An astronaut in a white spacesuit stands on grey lunar soil; the visor reflects the lunar module and photographer, and a long shadow crosses boot prints.
alt.zh: 身穿白色宇航服的宇航员站在灰色月壤上；面罩映出月球舱和摄影者，长长的影子横过靴印。

interpretation.en: The mission photograph documents lunar surface work, while the atlas map marks the launch site on Earth. The image is one part of a mission also dependent on Michael Collins in lunar orbit and extensive ground teams.
interpretation.zh: 任务照片记录月面活动，而地图标记的是地球上的发射地点。照片只是任务的一部分，任务还依靠留在月球轨道上的迈克尔·柯林斯及庞大的地面团队。

note.en: NARA explicitly names astronaut Neil Armstrong as the photographer and identifies NASA record 255-AMP-AS11-40-5903_alt in RG 255, Photographs of the Apollo Space Program. This was created during an official federal space mission.
note.zh: 国家档案馆明确注明宇航员尼尔·阿姆斯特朗为摄影者，并标识其为RG 255阿波罗太空计划照片系列中的NASA档案255-AMP-AS11-40-5903_alt。照片创作于官方联邦太空任务中。

creator.zh: 尼尔·A. 阿姆斯特朗；美国国家航空航天局

date.zh: 1969年7月20日（国家档案馆目录日期）

title.zh: 瓦茨拉夫·哈维尔1998年的国事访问抵达仪式

caption.en: Czech President Václav Havel, left, stands with President Bill Clinton for the U.S. national anthem on the White House South Lawn, 16 September 1998.
caption.zh: 1998年9月16日，捷克总统瓦茨拉夫·哈维尔（左）与美国总统比尔·克林顿在白宫南草坪肃立聆听美国国歌。

alt.en: Václav Havel and Bill Clinton stand in dark suits outdoors; Clinton holds his right hand over his chest.
alt.zh: 瓦茨拉夫·哈维尔与比尔·克林顿身穿深色西装站在户外；克林顿把右手放在胸前。

interpretation.en: The anthem ceremony presents Havel as president of the Czech Republic in 1998. It belongs to the later chapter of a life that moved from theatre and Charter 77 dissent through the 1989 transition into constitutional office.
interpretation.zh: 国歌仪式呈现1998年身为捷克共和国总统的哈维尔。这是他人生中较晚的篇章，此前经历了戏剧创作、《七七宪章》异议活动及1989年转型，随后担任宪制公职。

items.creator: Sharon Farmer; White House Photograph Office
items.institution: William J. Clinton Presidential Library and Museum

note.en: The exact gallery entry P66443-34 identifies the date and photographer Sharon Farmer. The Library states that photographs produced by White House photographers are public domain and asks for Library and photographer credit. This is an official 1998 White House photograph, not a private pre-presidential image.
note.zh: 确切图库条目P66443-34注明日期及摄影者莎伦·法默。图书馆说明白宫摄影人员制作的照片属于公有领域，并要求注明图书馆和摄影者。此件是1998年白宫官方照片，并非任职前私人照片。

creator.zh: 莎伦·法默；白宫摄影办公室

institution.en: William J. Clinton Presidential Library and Museum
institution.zh: 威廉·J. 克林顿总统图书馆与博物馆

title.en: A family in a 1944 agricultural labour photograph
title.zh: 1944年农业劳工照片中的一家人

caption.en: A family looks from a train window in the U.S. Department of Agriculture’s 1944 “Photograph of Mexican Laborers.” DocsTeach places the image in the Bracero Program’s cross-border labour context.
caption.zh: 一家人从火车窗口向外看；此图是美国农业部1944年的《墨西哥劳工照片》。DocsTeach将其置于布拉塞罗计划的跨境劳动背景中。

alt.en: Four people look out from a railcar window; the person at left raises two fingers and a child stands at the front.
alt.zh: 四人从车厢窗口向外看；左侧人物举起两根手指，一名儿童站在前面。

interpretation.en: The image makes household travel visible, but the source does not name the family or establish their individual contracts. A government photograph cannot show whether promised pay and housing protections were fulfilled.
interpretation.zh: 照片让家庭出行变得可见，但来源没有提供家人姓名，也不能确立每个人的合约身份。政府照片无法说明承诺的工资与住房保障是否兑现。

items.creator: U.S. Department of Agriculture, Central Photographic Office
items.institution: U.S. National Archives; image supplied by DocsTeach

note.en: DocsTeach identifies 16-N-6166 as a 1944 photograph from the Central Photographic Office of the Department of Agriculture, RG 16, and labels this primary source “Public Domain, Free of Known Copyright Restrictions.” This item-specific label and federal photographic-office creation support reuse; the site’s separate educational-content licence is not applied to the image.
note.zh: DocsTeach注明16-N-6166为1944年农业部中央摄影办公室照片，属RG 16，并将此原始资料标为“公有领域，无已知版权限制”。条目特定标识与联邦摄影办公室的制作来源支持使用；网站教育内容的另行许可不套用于此照片。

creator.en: U.S. Department of Agriculture, Central Photographic Office
creator.zh: 美国农业部中央摄影办公室

title.en: Rachel Carson during her federal scientific career
title.zh: 蕾切尔·卡森在联邦科学工作时期

caption.en: The U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service identifies this portrait as Rachel Carson, author, editor and aquatic biologist, circa 1944.
caption.zh: 美国鱼类与野生动物管理局将此肖像认定为约1944年的蕾切尔·卡森，当时她从事写作、编辑与水生生物学工作。

alt.en: A black-and-white head-and-shoulders portrait of Rachel Carson, smiling and wearing a jacket with a light pointed collar.
alt.zh: 蕾切尔·卡森的黑白半身肖像，她面带微笑，穿着浅色尖领外套。

interpretation.en: This portrait belongs to Carson’s government-science period, before The Sea Around Us and Silent Spring. Her work as a biologist and editor preceded the books that brought ecological relationships to a wider public.
interpretation.zh: 肖像属于卡森从事政府科学工作的时期，早于《我们周围的海洋》和《寂静的春天》。她先从事生物学与编辑工作，随后通过著作让更多公众了解生态关系。

note.en: The exact FWS media record credits USFWS, dates the photograph circa 1944 and explicitly lists “Media Usage Rights/License: Public Domain.” This is item-specific author and rights evidence.
note.zh: 确切的鱼类与野生动物管理局媒体记录署名USFWS，注明照片约摄于1944年，并明确列出“媒体使用权利／许可：公有领域”。这提供了条目特定的作者与权利证据。

title.en: An opening in the Berlin Wall at Potsdamer Platz
title.zh: 波茨坦广场的柏林墙开口

caption.en: West Berliners gather at a newly opened gap in the Berlin Wall at Potsdamer Platz on 14 November 1989, five days after border crossings first opened.
caption.zh: 1989年11月14日，西柏林居民聚集在波茨坦广场柏林墙的新开口旁；距边境通道最初开放已过五天。

alt.en: A crowd gathers between graffiti-covered sections of wall; several people stand on large bins to look through the opening.
alt.zh: 人群聚集在涂鸦覆盖的墙段之间；几人站在大型垃圾箱上向开口处张望。

interpretation.en: People climb onto bins to see through a new gap in a barrier that had divided the city. This is 14 November, after crossings first opened on 9 November 1989. German reunification followed in 1990.
interpretation.zh: 人们站上垃圾箱，透过曾分隔城市的屏障新开出的缺口向外看。此时是11月14日，晚于1989年11月9日边境通道首次开放；德国统一则发生在1990年。

items.creator: Staff Sgt. F. Lee Corkran; U.S. Department of Defense

note.en: NARA identifies the image as 330-CFD-DF-ST-91-01380 with a dated caption. Its embedded item metadata names Staff Sgt. F. Lee Corkran. The photographer’s military rank and official Combined Military Service image series establish federal production, not merely archival custody.
note.zh: 国家档案馆以带日期的说明标识此图为330-CFD-DF-ST-91-01380，嵌入条目元数据署名F. 李·科克兰参谋军士。摄影者的军人身份和官方联合军种图像系列确立联邦制作来源，而非仅依赖馆藏身份。

title.en: Martin Luther King Jr. at the March on Washington
title.zh: 华盛顿大游行中的小马丁·路德·金

caption.en: Martin Luther King Jr. speaks at the March on Washington on 28 August 1963, in a photograph filed by the U.S. Information Agency.
caption.zh: 1963年8月28日，小马丁·路德·金在华盛顿大游行中演讲；此照片存于美国新闻署档案中。

alt.en: Martin Luther King Jr. is seen in profile speaking into microphones; another man’s hat and head partly fill the foreground.
alt.zh: 小马丁·路德·金侧身对着话筒演讲；另一名男子的帽子与头部占据部分前景。

interpretation.en: King addresses the 1963 march at a bank of microphones. The tight framing concentrates on the speaker; the many organizers and participants who made the march possible extend beyond this view.
interpretation.zh: 金在一排话筒前向1963年游行群众发表讲话。紧凑的取景集中于演讲者，使游行得以开展的众多组织者和参与者则延伸到画面之外。

items.creator: U.S. Information Agency; photographer not named in the item record
items.institution: U.S. National Archives; image supplied by DocsTeach

note.en: DocsTeach identifies the exact image, NAID 542069, in the U.S. Information Agency’s Miscellaneous Subjects, Staff and Stringer Photographs and explicitly labels the primary source “Public Domain, Free of Known Copyright Restrictions.” The Nixon Library independently captions the same NAID and date. The clearance is for the photograph, not the speech.
note.zh: DocsTeach将确切图像NAID 542069归入美国新闻署的杂项主题、职员与特约摄影照片系列，并明确将此原始资料标为“公有领域，无已知版权限制”。尼克松图书馆也独立注明相同档案编号和日期。使用依据针对照片，不涵盖演讲内容。
